query: INSERT INTO role_binding(id, workspace_id, actor_id, role_id, scope_id, created, created_by) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, requested.role_id, requested.scope_id, NOW(), $5 FROM UNNEST($3::UUID[], $4::UUID[]) AS requested(role_id, scope_id) ON CONFLICT (actor_id, role_id, scope_id) DO NOTHING;
